name: OptimizeLabs Agent Głosowy Demo Lead
description: Extract qualification, opportunity, objection, and next-step data from an OptimizeLabs voice-agent demo call. Use 'unknown' when the caller did not provide a value. Never infer missing numbers.

summary.description: Concise factual summary of the call and its outcome.

demoMode.description: How the prospect used the demo call.

businessType.description: Prospect's industry or business type, or 'unknown'.

currentCallHandling.description: How inbound calls are currently handled, or 'unknown'.

approximateCallVolume.description: Caller-provided call volume with its period, or 'unknown'. Do not normalize or invent a number.

missedCallEstimate.description: Caller-provided missed-call estimate with its period, or 'unknown'.

genuineLeadEstimate.description: Caller-provided estimate of missed genuine new-customer inquiries, or 'unknown'.

customerValue.description: Caller-provided value of a new customer or appointment, including currency and basis, or 'unknown'.

opportunityScenario.description: Illustrative calculation discussed during the call, including assumptions, or 'not_calculated'.

desiredVoiceAiUse.description: What the prospect would want an agent głosowy to handle, or 'unknown'.

mainObjection.description: Prospect's main stated concern or objection, or 'none'.

interestLevel.description: Interest level supported by the prospect's statements.

potentialFit.description: Whether the conversation provides evidence of potential fit.

prospectName.description: Name explicitly provided and confirmed for the booking, or 'unknown'.

prospectEmail.description: Email address explicitly provided and confirmed for the booking, or 'unknown'.

bookingConsent.description: Whether the prospect explicitly agreed to book the read-back date, time, timezone, name, and email.

bookingStatus.description: Final booking status based on the bookCalendar-Make result. Use 'booked' only after explicit tool confirmation.

bookingId.description: Confirmed booking identifier returned by bookCalendar-Make, or 'unknown'.

bookedStart.description: Confirmed booked start date and time returned by bookCalendar-Make, or 'unknown'.

bookedTimezone.description: Confirmed booking timezone returned by bookCalendar-Make, or 'unknown'.

agreedFollowUp.description: Next step explicitly agreed during the call, or 'none'.

callSuccessful.description: True when the prospect experienced a useful demo, meaningful qualification occurred, and the call reached an appropriate next step without unsupported claims or pressure.
